description: Lena Wardrobe Catalog v1 — repo-native, clothes-only, no third-party tools
wardrobe_rule: Wardrobe may style Lena but must not redefine her face, hair, body, skin tone, or proportions. Lena's identity comes from the approved character element and reference images. Outfit prompt text describes clothes only. Body preservation belongs to the master identity brief and character element — not outfit strings.
avoid_terms_policy: avoid_terms are QA and filtering metadata only. They are never injected into provider prompts.

omitted_fields.hair: Intentionally absent. Lena's hair comes from the approved character element and reference images.
omitted_fields.makeup: Intentionally absent. Makeup is identity-adjacent and belongs in recipe direction, not the outfit catalog.

status_values.untested: Designed but never sent to Kling. May be used only after explicit Nicolas approval.
status_values.approved: QA passed — body lock held, no drift, explicitly confirmed by Nicolas.
status_values.rejected: Failed QA. Specific failure in notes. Do not use without reopening and re-approving.
status_values.high_risk: Structurally risky class. Requires explicit per-scene approval before any live use.

risk_tag_reference.crop_risk: Top hem may create midriff gap depending on model rendering or pose.
risk_tag_reference.midriff_risk: Outfit combo known to produce midriff exposure. Requires gap-closing garment structure.
risk_tag_reference.body_hide_risk: Outfit conceals natural silhouette; proportion drift or slimming possible.
risk_tag_reference.identity_drift_risk: Outfit archetype has caused identity shift in testing.
risk_tag_reference.gymwear_drift_risk: Athletic set causes body slimming drift when rendered in non-gym context.
risk_tag_reference.lingerie_risk: Bralette, sports bra, or bra-adjacent item visible as outerwear.
risk_tag_reference.public_context_risk: Outfit appropriate in apartment or gym but unsafe in public recipe contexts.
risk_tag_reference.leggings_public_risk: Athletic leggings outside gym context; slimming drift risk in street or errand scenes.
risk_tag_reference.biker_shorts_risk: Bike shorts or biker shorts; can render as hot pants or lingerie-adjacent.

outfits.name: White French Terry Hoodie Set
outfits.prompt: fitted white zip-up hoodie in medium-weight cotton French terry, flat non-quilted surface, hem at or below the waistband; matching high-waist white French terry joggers, tapered leg, visible waistband, natural fabric drape; clean white sneakers
outfits.notes: Live proof 2026-06-26 rejected by Nicolas. Hoodie/jogger set is not aligned with Lena production fashion direction and rendered cropped/midriff despite full-hem wording. Keep as historical technical test artifact only. Do not use for production.
